notes: Identity independently checked: title The Effects of an Implemental Mind-Set on Attitude Strength; authors Marlone D. Henderson, Yaël de Liver, and Peter M. Supplied canonical text is a primary journal article parse with methods, results, references and appendices, rather than an abstract or secondary report. No PDF was supplied; no rendering was possible. Only assigned fields are completed; other fields/sides are placeholders. Target not assigned by row order or numeric matching.
